_purpose: Bounds and forbidden patterns for the Skill Manager. Mirrors reflection_constraints.json — Hermes lets the LLM curate SKILL.md files freely with no policy layer; we bound them so a malicious or buggy skill can't quietly steer all future tasks. Edit here to tune aggressiveness of skill creation / retrieval.

creation_limits._doc: Hard caps on what a single task can create. Hermes will let the LLM write a 4KB SKILL.md every turn; we cap to one short skill per task to keep memory drift small.

retrieval._doc: Pre-planner injection: at task start, runtime asks SkillManager.find_relevant(goal) for the top-N matches via BM25 over skill descriptions+names. Only ACTIVE skills are returned — archived ones never inject.
retrieval._cross_context_doc: P2 (option B) cross-tool transfer lane. min_score_for_injection above is kept conservative ON PURPOSE (a missed skill is harmless — the task just runs without a head-start; a wrongly-injected one can mislead). This SEPARATE lower threshold fires ONLY as a fallback when normal retrieval found nothing, ONLY for the categories listed, and ONLY returns skills whose stored tool differs from the task's target tool — each of which must then survive adaptation + the verifier's strict mode. We do NOT lower the global threshold to chase cross-medium matches.

lifecycle._doc: Phase 2 L4.8 — 4-state lifecycle (active/stale/superseded/archived). Skills are NEVER auto-deleted. lifecycle_sweep auto-applies the only reversible low-risk transition (ACTIVE->STALE when unused past active_to_stale_days_unused); STALE->ARCHIVED and ACTIVE->SUPERSEDED are emitted as proposals for the 105 human gate. Retrieval weights below scale a skill's match score by status: ACTIVE=1.0 (implicit), STALE=stale_retrieval_weight, SUPERSEDED=superseded_retrieval_weight (0.0 = excluded), ARCHIVED always excluded.

forbidden_patterns._doc: Regex patterns (case-insensitive) that cause skill creation to be REJECTED — same defense as reflection_constraints, applied to both name and body. A malicious skill would otherwise be injected into every future planning brief, so this is a critical hook.

min_task_quality._doc: The skill_manager tool refuses to create a skill from a trivial / failed task. The agent should only create skills from substantive successful work — not from one-shot chit-chat.

distiller._doc: Phase 1A — Skill Distiller (Module 109B) trigger config. Auto-proposes a skill draft after qualified successful tasks. Draft enters Curator queue as proposal kind 'create_skill'; user must approve before write. 8 checks across 6 dimensions: enabled / category-exclude / verifier-pass / route / cumulative-quality / recency / dedup / rate-limit. Demo override: set SKILL_AUTO_PROPOSE_MIN_SUCCESSES=5 env var.

pii_extra_patterns._doc: Phase 1A — PII scanning ON TOP OF forbidden_patterns. Two categories: (a) hard_reject — kill the entire proposal (real PII / credentials); (b) redact — sanitize in-place and keep the skill (low-value PII like local file paths). forbidden_patterns above already covers prompt-injection + API key shapes (sk-/gsk_/AIza/password/secret/token), so we do NOT duplicate those here.
